FX-TDISP-001.says: As added: Max Displacement 1 second, Time Resolution 60, the layer's own brightness as the map, Stretch: each pixel from a moment chosen by its own brightness; moments past the layer's twelve frames are clear.

FX-TDISP-002.says: The ramp as the map, black at the left to white at the right, Max 0.5: column x is 4 x - 30 sixtieths of a second from now, so column 0 shows frame 1 and column 15 frame 11 at frame 6; at frame 0 the left half asks for frames before the layer, clear.

FX-TDISP-003.says: The same at Max -0.5: the other way, the left shows the frames after.

FX-TDISP-004.says: The ramp, Max 0.5, Time Resolution 2: moments in half seconds, so only frames 1, 6 and 11 are seen.

FX-TDISP-005.says: The ramp, Max 0.4, Time Resolution 3: a third of a second is 3.33 frames, held to the frame holding it: frame 9 after and frame 2 before.

FX-TDISP-006.says: The ramp, Max 0.5, Time Resolution 100, past the frame rate: every pixel is still one of the drawings, nothing in between; the same frame as FX-TDISP-002.

FX-TDISP-007.says: The layer from frame 3 to frame 8 only: the moments outside it are clear.

FX-TDISP-008.says: A small map, 4 by 2 steps of grey, stretched over the layer.

FX-TDISP-009.says: The same map centred: outside it there is no map, so no shift.

FX-TDISP-011.says: An orange solid as the map: its brightness, 0.664, is 20 sixtieths of a second, so the whole layer is 3 frames ahead: frame 6 shows frame 9.

FX-TDISP-012.says: A white map at half covering, laid over mid grey: half the way to white, 30 sixtieths, so frame 6 shows frame 11.

FX-TDISP-013.says: The ramp with an Exposure of -1 on it: a map's effects count (D-189), so it is darker and every column reaches further back.

FX-TDISP-014.says: A mask keeping columns 0 to 7: every moment is masked; the left half is FX-TDISP-002's.

FX-TDISP-015.says: An Exposure of +1 before it is not seen: the moments are the drawings and the layer's own map is its drawing. FX-TDISP-001.

FX-TDISP-016.says: An Exposure of -1 after it darkens the result.

FX-TDISP-017.says: The holder moved 2 right and 1 down: FX-TDISP-002 moved, since the map lies on the layer.

FX-TDISP-018.says: The effect on an adjustment layer above the holder: nothing changes.

FX-TDISP-019.says: Max keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 1 at frame 12, the ramp: at frame 0 nothing moves; at frame 6 it is 0.5, FX-TDISP-002.

FX-TDISP-020.says: Max 0: every pixel from now, the layer as it is.

FX-TDISP-021.says: A layer that is not in the composition, `gone`: the layer itself is the map, FX-TDISP-001, and the warning every frame.

FX-TDISP-022.says: Max 10.5 seconds, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TDISP-023.says: Max -10.5 seconds, below -10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TDISP-024.says: Time Resolution 0.5, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TDISP-025.says: Time Resolution 1000, above 999. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TDISP-026.says: A fit written "fill". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TDISP-027.says: A layer written as the number 3, not a word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TDISP-028.says: Max keyed to 12 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
